rfqRoute: A European cosmetic packaging inquiry should start with product type: jar box, skincare set, makeup box, sleeve, insert or retail gift set.
The RFQ should confirm product dimensions, fill weight or container size, retail channel, insert/protection need, finish direction and artwork status.
For Europe-facing beauty projects, the useful next step is project review and document confirmation, not a fixed MOQ or lead-time promise.
If the buyer is comparing suppliers, route them to the factory guide first, then the cosmetic packaging product page and quote checklist.
Evaluate this route with GA4 key events and GSC query/page movement before changing Ads bids or budget.
